description: The fill-percentage band a foreman has set for one container type at one company — the CURRENT settings a checker's phone reads, not a history of every value it has ever held (that is Fill Threshold Change Log). One row per (company, container_type): update_fill_threshold edits this row in place and bumps version rather than inserting a new one, because a container type has exactly one threshold in force at a time. lower_bound_pct is the underfill line every container type has; upper_bound_pct is the overfill line and is left blank for a container that physically cannot be overfilled (a cherry bucket) — nothing in this app hardcodes that by container_type name, a caller simply never sets it.

fields.description: e.g. 'cherry_bucket', 'pear_bin'. A free-text key, not a Select — a new container type is a new value here and needs no code release, which is what makes the pipeline container-agnostic.
fields.label: Container Type

fields.description: Bumped by update_fill_threshold on every change. What a checker's acknowledgment is recorded against — Fill Threshold Acknowledgment rows name the version they acknowledged, and list_pending_threshold_acknowledgments compares that against this number.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Below this percentage, a bucket or bin is underfilled. Every container type has one.
fields.label: Lower Bound %

fields.description: Above this percentage, a container is overfilled. Blank means this container type cannot overfill (a cherry bucket has a rim; nothing above it counts against the picker).
fields.label: Upper Bound %

fields.description: The identity update_fill_threshold attributed the current values to — an Employee, User or service account, whichever the caller resolved to. Full history of every change, not just this one, is Fill Threshold Change Log.
fields.label: Last Updated By

name: Container Fill Threshold
